claims.claim: The Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) named Brian Mazanec acting executive assistant director for infrastructure security.
claims.bestSource: CISA Names Brian Bonacci Emergency Communications Chief, Brian Mazanec Acting Infrastructure Security EAD - ExecutiveGov
claims.evidence: The Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency has appointed Brian Bonacci to lead its emergency communications division and named Brian Mazanec acting executive assistant director for infrastructure security . Brian Mazanec, who previously oversaw health-sector preparedness at the Department of Health and Human Services, has been sworn in as acting executive assistant director for infrastructure security at CISA.

claims.claim: He will oversee CISA’s Infrastructure Security Division, which works with government and private‑sector partners to identify vulnerabilities, manage risks, and improve resilience across the nation’s 16 critical infrastructure sectors.
